gaps.discriminates: VWD vs. qualitative platelet disorders (e.g., low VWF:RCo supports VWD; normal VWF:RCo with abnormal platelet aggregation suggests intrinsic platelet defect)
Distinguishes VWD type 1 (low VWF:Ag), type 2 (normal/low VWF:Ag but low function), or type 3 (undetectable VWF:Ag); also helps exclude pseudo-VWD or assay interference

Collagen/epinephrine closure time is typically prolonged in VWD and many platelet function disorders; a normal result would strongly argue against both, while abnormality alone does not differentiate — but combined with VWF assays, it increases diagnostic specificity
